entities.name: RRC Connection Establishment
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish RRC connection when upper layers request it while UE is in RRC_IDLE with valid system information.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE initiates connection establishment procedure.

entities.name: RRCSetupRequest
entities.description: Message transmitted by UE to initiate RRC connection establishment.

entities.name: T300
entities.description: Timer started when UE initiates RRC connection establishment procedure.

entities.name: Upper layer request for RRC connection
entities.description: Condition where upper layers request establishment of RRC connection.

entities.name: Valid essential system information
entities.description: Condition where UE has acquired and maintains valid essential system information.

entities.name: Unified Access Control
entities.description: Procedure performed when upper layers provide Access Category and Access Identities.

entities.name: Access attempt barred
entities.description: Condition where unified access control procedure results in barred access.

entities.name: L2 U2N Remote UE
entities.description: Condition where UE is connected with L2 U2N Relay UE via PC5-RRC connection.

relations.description: Procedure initiation requires upper layer request for RRC connection.
Procedure initiation requires UE to be in RRC_IDLE state.
Procedure initiation requires valid essential system information.
Procedure includes unified access control when Access Category/Identities provided.
Unified access control procedure may establish access barred condition.
Access barred condition stops the RRC connection establishment procedure.
Procedure behavior is guarded by L2 U2N Remote UE condition.
Procedure starts timer T300 upon initiation.
Procedure includes transmission of RRCSetupRequest message.
